title: Erdős #1012: Exact Value of f(k) for Pancyclic Graphs

problemStatement.formal: axiom woodall_theorem (n k : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 2 * k + 3) : hasLongCycle n k
problemStatement.plain: Let f(k) be the minimum n₀ such that every graph on n ≥ n₀ vertices with at least C(n-k-1, 2) + C(k+2, 2) + 1 edges contains a cycle on n-k vertices. Determine f(k). Answer: f(k) ≤ 2k+3 (Woodall 1972).
whyMatters: Fundamental problem in extremal graph theory
Connects edge density to cycle structure
Resolved by Woodall with surprising pancyclicity result

proven: Edge threshold computations (k=0, k=1, concrete values)
Structural consequences of Ore, Bondy, Woodall theorems
Woodall bound is at least 3 for all k
Ore/Bondy improve Woodall for small k
